caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical composition consisting of several distinct objects and shapes, rendered in a color palette of gold, red, and blue, all set against a beige textured background. At the top, there is a stylized cross outlined in red with gold and blue accents and radiating gold lines behind it. Below the cross, there is a four-petal bow-like element made of elongated gold shapes, each bordered with blue and containing red and blue dotted patterns, and with a circular design featuring an "X" where the petals intersect. On either side of this bow element, two gold wing-like shapes extend outward, each with three red-tipped segments. Centrally positioned beneath these shapes is a large circular medallion, bordered in red, filled with an intricate geometric pattern consisting of concentric rings of stylized arrow and petal shapes in blue, gold, and red, with a small blue circle at the center. The motifs are arranged vertically and aligned along the central axis of the image, and the style employs stylized lines and repetitive geometric elements.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
